terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A parked vehicle prop: an exterior shell with no interior geometry, since a prop kit is only ever looked at from outside and the glazing is authored as a tinted, mostly opaque pane. The wheels are the mechanisms: each is a named pivot on its axle. Nothing else moves and nothing attaches, so there are no sockets. A two-wheeled walking tractor towing a flatbed trailer. The plate shows a faded red fuel tank and gearbox over a black single-cylinder engine with a silver flywheel cover, two big lugged mud tyres, long rusted handlebars with black grips, a timber drawbar and A-frame, and a grey planked trailer with stakes and top rails on two small rubber wheels.

reasoning: Two bodies joined by a drawbar: a red-and-black single-cylinder tractor on two big lugged wheels with long handlebars swept back over the trailer, and a planked flatbed trailer on two small wheels. The layout is read off the proxy side elevation.

Three materials: paint (red hood and gearbox, black engine, timber-brown drawbar as vertex colours, with a rust canvas), a white vertex-coloured trim (rust handlebars, axles, tyres, trailer wheels) and a timber material with the plank canvas.
One repetition system: the two drive wheels off one lugged lathe; the trailer wheels are a loose lathe merged into the trim.
Action readiness: four axle pivots and a hitch pivot on the trailer component, convex collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The tractor is a cluster of small solids (block, head, tank, gearbox, flywheel cover) that reads as an engine only when they step in and out of each other; the trailer is a box of boards with stakes and rails, and the daylight under it and between the handlebars is the vehicle, not a hole.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: The turntable gate's enclosed-background signal fires on the daylight between the handlebars, under the trailer and around the drawbar: real open air. --allow-holes is set on the _holecc measurement.
The lugged tread is not modelled as lugs; the tyre is a smooth lathe in the measured mud-brown, the lugs being below the resolvable band at prop distance.
The far side is mirrored; the exhaust stub is on the left.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.50 x 1.35 x 4.20 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus one named pivot per wheel (5); zero sockets; convex collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this vehicle in the kit and nothing is emitted from it; a marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center at tyre contact, +Y up, +Z FORWARD, +X the vehicle's left. silhouette.description: Drive wheels 0.84 m at z +1.55 on a 1.24 m track; engine block 0.45-0.75 m and tank to 0.97 m over z 1.40-1.90; handlebars from 0.78 m at z 1.30 rising to 1.32 m at z -0.20 with grips to x +-0.46; tow bar at 0.52 m from z 1.08 to the hitch pin at z 0.30, where the trailer A-frame (two 0.86 m beams from the chassis-beam noses at x +-0.52) meets it; bumper loop 0.88 m wide at 0.28 m, z 2.08; trailer deck at 0.72 m from z -0.20 to -2.10, boards to 1.06 m, wheels 0.56 m at z -1.40 on a 1.40 m track.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.77..+0.77 at the trailer wheels; y 0.00 to 1.36 at the handlebar grips; z -2.11..+2.07 tailboard to skid bar, +Z forward. The Meshy proxy normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.391 : 0.338 (2.56 lengths tall against the declared 3.11), so heights are proxy fractions of H and stations fractions of L at the declared metres.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.391 : 0.338. Its side elevation (scratch/iron-buffalo-walking-tractor/_ev/side.png) reads engine 0.02-0.22 L to 0.90 H, big wheel 0.10-0.30 L to 0.62 H, handlebars rising from 0.20 L at 0.55 H to 0.55 L at 1.00 H over the trailer, drawbar 0.30-0.55 L at 0.45 H, trailer bed 0.55-0.98 L at 0.55-0.80 H, trailer wheels at 0.78 L to 0.42 H -- and those fractions at the declared 4.20 m are what is built.

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout: three components and one InstancedMesh at 4 draw calls of 4.

User review: the trailer was not connected to the tractor. The drawbar and A-frame had been authored in the tractor body merge at y 0.46 and ended in mid-air 0.20 m below and 0.15 m short of the trailer chassis beams (y 0.67, x +-0.52). reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.85. 2,688/4,000 triangles, 4/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 4/6 unique geometries, two canvases at 1.7 MB, factory 44 ms. Turntable: enclosed background is the open frame, allowed on measurement.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components and one repetition system: 4 of 4. The trailer wheels ride the trim merge so the trailer can have its own material and its own pivot.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 2,688 of 4,000: four wheel lathes and boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tinted boxes and cylinders for the engine cluster, polyline tubes for the bars, lathes for the wheels, boxes for the trailer.
One InstancedMesh carries the two drive wheels; the trailer wheels are merged.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. Two canvases after construction: a 512 px plank tile on the timber as map and bump, a 256 px rust tile on the paint. 1.7 MB of texture VRAM, factory 44 ms.
